Tableegh-e-Deen mein faqeer-o-ghani sab barabar. Bahut se mufassireen se marvi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ek martaba Quraish ke sardaron ko Islami taleem samjha rahe thay aur mashghooli ke sath unki taraf mutawajja thay. Dil mein khayal tha ke kya ajab Allah inhe Islam naseeb kar de. Nagahan Hazrat Abdullah bin Umm-e-Maktum R.A aap ﷺ ke paas aaye, purane Musalman thay, umooman Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hote rehte thay aur duniya-e-Islam ki taleem seekhte rehte thay aur masail daryaft kiya karte thay. Aaj bhi hasb-e-adat aate hi sawalat shuru kiye aur aage barh barh kar Huzoor ﷺ ko apni taraf mutawajja karna chaha. Aap ﷺ chunke us waqt ek ahem amr-e-deeni mein poori tarah mashghool thay, unki taraf tawajjah na farmayi balkay zara garan-e-khatir guzra aur peshani par bal par gaye. Is par yeh aayatein nazil huin ke aap ﷺ ki buland shaan aur aala akhlaq ke laiq yeh baat na thi ke us nabina se jo hamare khauf se daurta bhagta aap ﷺ ki khidmat mein ilm-e-deen seekhne ke liye aaye aur aap ﷺ us se munh pher lein aur unki taraf mutawajja hain jo sarkash hain aur maghroor-o-mutakabbir hain. Bahut mumkin hai ke yahi pak ho jaye aur Allah ki baatein sun kar buraiyon se bach jaye aur ahkam ki tameel mein tayyar ho jaye. Yeh kya kaha aap ﷺ un be-parwah logon ki janib tamam-tar tawajjah farma lein? Aap ﷺ par koi unko rah-e-rast par la khara karna zaroori thore hi hai? Woh agar aap ﷺ ki baatein na maanein to aap ﷺ par unke aamal ki pakar hargiz nahin. Matlab yeh hai ke tableegh-e-deen mein shareef-o-zaeef, faqeer-o-ghani, azad-o-ghulam, mard-o-aurat, chote bare sab barabar hain. Aap ﷺ sab ko yaksan nasihat kiya karein. Hidayat Allah ke hath hai, woh agar kisi ko rah-e-rast se door rakhe to uski hikmat wahi janta hai, jise apni rah laga le use bhi wahi khoob janta hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Umm-e-Maktum ke aane ke waqt Huzoor ﷺ ka mukhatib Ubay bin Khalaf tha. Iske baad Huzoor ﷺ Ibn-e-Umm-e-Maktum ki bari takreem aur aao-bhagat kiya karte thay (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Hazrat Anas R.A farmate hain main ne Ibn-e-Umm-e-Maktum ko Qadisiya ki larai mein dekha hai, zirah pehne hue thay aur siyah jhanda liye hue thay. Hazrat Ayesha R.A farmati hain ke jab yeh aaye aur kehne lage ke Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ mujhe bhalai ki baatein sikhaiye, us waqt ru'asa-e-Quraish aap ﷺ ki majlis mein thay. Aap ﷺ ne unki taraf poori tawajjah na farmayi, unhein samjhate jate thay aur farmate thay kaho meri baat theek hai? Woh kehte jate thay haan Hazrat durust hai. In logon mein Utba bin Rabia, Abu Jahl bin Hisham, Abbas bin Abdul Muttalib thay. Aap ﷺ ki bari koshish thi aur poori hirs thi ke kis tarah yeh log deen-e-haq ko qabool kar lein. Idhar yeh aa gaye aur kehne lage Huzoor ﷺ Quran-e-Pak ki koi aayat mujhe sunaiye aur Allah ki baatein sikhaiye. Aap ﷺ ko us waqt unki baat zara be-mauqa lagi aur munh pher liya aur udhar hi mutawajja rahe. Jab un se baatein poori kar ke aap ﷺ ghar jaane lage to aankhon tale andhera chha gaya aur sar neecha ho gaya aur yeh aayatein utrein. Phir to aap ﷺ unki bari izzat kiya karte thay aur poori tawajjah se kaan laga kar unki baatein suna karte thay, aate jate har waqt puchte ke kuch kaam hai? Kuch haajat hai? Kuch kehte ho? Kuch mangte ho? (Ibn-e-Jareer waghera). Yeh riwayat ghareeb aur munkar hai aur iski sanad mein bhi kalam hai. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A farmate hain ke main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna, aap ﷺ farmate thay ke Bilal raat rehte hue azan diya karte hain to tum sehri khate peete raho yahan tak ke Ibn-e-Umm-e-Maktum ki azan suno. Yeh woh nabina hain jin ke bare mein aayat (Abasa wa tawalla an ja'ahul a'ma) (80:1-2) utri thi. Yeh bhi muazzin thay, beenai mein nuqsan tha, jab log subh-e-sadiq dekh lete aur ittila karte ke subh hui tab yeh azan kaha karte thay (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim). Ibn-e-Umm-e-Maktum ka mashhoor naam to Abdullah hai, baaz ne kaha hai unka naam Amr hai, Wallahu A'lam. Innaha tazkirah yani yeh nasihat hai, is se murad ya to yeh surat hai ya yeh musawat ke tableegh-e-deen mein sab yaksan hain murad hai. Suddi kehte hain murad is se Quran hai. Jo shakhs chahe ise yaad kar le yani Allah ko yaad kare aur apne tamam kamon mein uske farman ko muqaddam rakhe, ya yeh matlab hai ke Wahi-e-Ilahi ko yaad kar le. Yeh surat aur yeh wa'z-o-nasihat balkay sare ka sara Quran muwaqqar, mu'azzaz aur mu'tabar sahifon mein hai jo buland qadr aur aala martaba wale hain, jo mail-kuchail aur kami-zyadti se mehfooz aur pak-saaf hain, jo farishton ke paas hathon mein hain aur yeh bhi matlab ho sakta hai ke as-hab-e-Rasool ﷺ ke pakeeza hathon mein hai.

Hazrat Qatadah R.A ka qaul hai ke is se murad qari hain. Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain ke yeh Nabti zaban ka lafz hai ma'ani hain qari, Imam Ibn Jarir R.H farmate hain sahih baat yahi hai ke is se murad farishtay hain jo Allah Ta'ala aur makhlooq ke darmiyan safeer hain, safeer usay kehte hain ke jo sulh aur bhalai ke liye logon mein koshish karta phire, Arab shair ke shair mein bhi yahi ma'ani paye jate hain, Imam Bukhari R.H farmate hain is se murad farishtay hain jo farishtay Allah ki janib se wahi waghera le kar aate hain woh aisay hi hain jaise logon mein sulh karane wale safeer hote hain, woh zahir batin mein pak hain, wajeeh khush-ru shareef aur buzurg zahir mein, akhlaq-o-af'aal ke pakeeza batin mein. Yahan se yeh bhi maloom karna chahiye ke Quran ke parhne walon ko a'maal-o-akhlaq achhay rakhne chahiyen, Musnad-e-Ahmad ki aik hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jo Quran ko parhay aur us ki maharat hasil kare woh buzurg likhne wale farishton ke sath hoga aur jo bawajood mushaqqat kabhi parhay usay dohra ajar mile ga.

Reerh ki haddi aur takhleeq-e-sani. Jo log marne ke baad jee uthne ke inkari thay un ki yahan muzammat bayan ho rahi hai, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yani insan par laanat ho yeh kitna bada nashukr guzar hai aur yeh bhi ma'ani bayan kiye gaye hain ke umooman tamam insan jhutlane wale hain bila daleel mehez apne khayal se ek cheez ko namumkin jaan kar bawajood ilmi sarmaya ki kami ke jhat se Allah ki baton ki takzeeb kar dete hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke use is jhutlane par kaunsi cheez amada karti hai? Is ke baad is ki asliyat jitayi jati hai ke woh khayal kare ke kis qadar haqeer aur zaleel cheez se Allah ne use banaya hai kya woh use dobara paida karne par qudrat nahin rakhta? Us ne insan ko mani ke qatre se paida kiya phir is ki taqdeer muqaddar ki yani umr, rozi, amal aur nek-o-bad hona likha. Phir is ke liye maa ke pet se nikalne ka rasta aasaan kar diya aur yeh bhi ma'ani hain ke hum ne apne deen ka rasta aasaan kar diya yani wazeh aur zahir kar diya jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Inna hadainahus sabeela imma shakiran wa imma kafoora) (Surah Al-Insan: 3) yani hum ne use raah dikhayi phir ya to woh shukr guzar bane ya nashukra, Hasan aur Ibn-e-Zaid isi ko rajeh batate hain wallahu a'alam. Is ki paidaish ke baad phir use maut di aur phir qabr mein le gaya. Arab ka muhawara hai ke woh jab kisi ko dafan karein to kehte hain: Qabartur rajula aur kehte hain Aqbaruhullah isi tarah ke aur bhi muhaware hain matlab yeh hai ke ab Allah ne use qabr wala bana diya. Phir jab Allah chahe ga use dobara zinda kar de ga, isi ki zindagi ko ba'asat bhi kehte hain aur nashoor bhi, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wa min ayatihi an khalaqakum min turabin thumma iza antum basharun tantashiroon) (Surah Ar-Rum: 20). Is ki nishaniyon mein se ek yeh bhi hai ke us ne tumhein mitti se paida kiya phir tum insan ban kar uth baithe aur jagah hai (Kaifa nunshizuha thumma naksuha lahman) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 259) haddiyon ko dekho ke hum kis tarah unhein uthate bithate hain, phir kis tarah unhein gosht chadhate hain. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya rai ke dane ke barabar hai isi se phir tumhari paidaish hogi. Yeh hadees baghair sawal-o-jawab ki ziyadati ke Bukhari Muslim mein bhi hai ke Ibn-e-Adam gal sad jata hai magar reerh ki haddi ke isi se paida kiya gaya hai aur isi se phir tarkeeb diya jaye ga. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmata hai ke jis tarah yeh nashukra aur be-qadr insan kehta hai ke us ne apni jaan-o-maal mein Allah ka jo haq tha woh ada kar diya lekin aisa hargiz nahin hai. Balkeh abhi to us ne faraiz-e-Allah se bhi sabakdoshi hasil nahin ki. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ka farman hai ke kisi shakhs se Allah Ta'ala ke faraiz ki poori adayegi nahin ho sakti.

Hasan Basri R.H se bhi aise hi ma'ani marwi hain. Mutaqaddimeen mein se main ne toh is ke siwa koi aur kalam nahin paya, haan mujhe is ke yeh ma'ani maloom hote hain ke farman-e-Bari ka yeh matlab hai ke phir jab chahe dobara paida kare ga, ab tak is ke faisle ke mutabiq waqt nahin aaya. Ya'ni abhi abhi woh aisa nahin kare ga yahan tak ke muddat-e-muqarrara khatam ho aur Bani Israel ki taqdeer poori ho, un ki qismat mein is duniya mein aana aur yahan bhala bura karna waghera jo muqaddar ho chuka hai. Woh sab Allah ke andaze ke mutabiq poora ho chuke, us waqt woh Khaliq-e-Kul dobara zinda kare ga aur jaise ke pehli martaba paida kiya tha ab doosri dafa phir paida kar de ga. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Wahb bin Munabbah R.H se marwi hai ke Hazrat Uzair A.S ne farmaya mere paas ek farishta aaya aur us ne mujh se kaha ke qabrein zameen ka pait hain aur zameen makhlooq ki maa hai jab ke kul makhlooq paida ho chuke gi phir qabron mein pahunch jaye gi aur qabrein sab bhar jayengi us waqt duniya ka silsila khatam ho jaye ga aur jo bhi zameen par honge sab mar jayenge. Aur zameen mein jo kuch hai use zameen ugal de gi aur qabron mein jo murde hain sab bahar nikal diye jayenge, yeh qaul hum apni is tafseer ki daleel mein pesh kar sakte hain. Wallahu Subhanahu wa Ta'ala A'lam. Phir irshad hota hai ke mere is ehsan ko dekhein ke main ne unhein khana diya, is mein bhi daleel hai maut ke baad jee uthne ki ke jis tarah khushk ghair-abad zameen se hum ne tar-o-taza darakht ugaye aur un se anaaj waghera paida kar ke tumhare liye khana muhayya kiya isi tarah gali sari khokhli aur choora choora haddiyon ko bhi hum ek roz zinda kar denge aur unhein gosht-post pehna kar dobara tumhein zinda kar denge, tum dekh lo ke hum ne aasman se barabar pani barsaya phir use hum ne zameen mein pahuncha kar thehra diya woh beej mein pahuncha aur zameen mein pade hue daanon mein sarayat ki jis se woh daane uge darakht phoota ooncha hua aur khetiyan lehlahane lagein, kahin anaaj paida hua kahin angoor aur kahin tarkariyan. Ghaliban "Ghulban" ke ma'ani khajooron ke bade bade mewa-dar darakht hain. Hada'iq kehte hain har us bagh ko jo ghana aur khoob bhara hua aur gehre saye wala aur bade darakhton wala ho, moti gardan wale aadmi ko bhi Arab Aghlab kehte hain, aur meway paida kiye aur Abb kehte hain zameen ki us sabzi ko jaise janwar khate hain aur insaan use nahin khate, jaise ghaas paat waghera, Abb janwar ke liye aisa hi hai jaisa insaan ke liye Fakiha ya'ni phal, mewa.

Reerh ki haddi aur takhleeq-e-sani. Jo log marne ke baad jee uthne ke inkari thay un ki yahan muzammat bayan ho rahi hai, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yani insan par laanat ho yeh kitna bada nashukr guzar hai aur yeh bhi ma'ani bayan kiye gaye hain ke umooman tamam insan jhutlane wale hain bila daleel mehez apne khayal se ek cheez ko namumkin jaan kar bawajood ilmi sarmaya ki kami ke jhat se Allah ki baton ki takzeeb kar dete hain aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke use is jhutlane par kaunsi cheez amada karti hai? Us ne insan ko mani ke qatre se paida kiya phir is ki taqdeer muqaddar ki yani umr, rozi, amal aur nek-o-bad hona likha. Is ki paidaish ke baad phir use maut di aur phir qabr mein le gaya. Arab ka muhawara hai ke woh jab kisi ko dafan karein to kehte hain: Qabartur rajula aur kehte hain Aqbaruhullah isi tarah ke aur bhi muhaware hain matlab yeh hai ke ab Allah ne use qabr wala bana diya. Balkeh abhi to us ne faraiz-e-Allah se bhi sabakdoshi hasil nahin ki. Hazrat Mujahid (R.H) ka farman hai ke kisi shakhs se Allah Ta'ala ke faraiz ki poori adayegi nahin ho sakti.

Woh kahegi ke beshak aap ne mere saath bahut hi achha sulook kiya, bahut pyar mohabbat se rakha. Yeh kahega ke aaj mujhe zaroorat hai, sirf ek neki de do taake is aafat se chhoot jaon, to woh jawab degi ke sawal thodi si cheez ka hi hai magar kya karoon, yahi zaroorat mujhe darpesh hai aur isi ka khauf mujhe lag raha hai, main to neki nahin de sakti. Beta baap se milega, yahi kahega aur yahi jawab payega.

Sahih hadith mein shafa'at ka bayan farmate hue Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke 'Ulul-Azm' paighambaron se log shafa'at ki talab karenge aur un mein se har ek yahi kahega ke "Nafsi Nafsi" (meri jaan, meri jaan). Yahan tak ke Hazrat Isa Roohullah (Alaihis Salam) bhi yahi farmayenge ke aaj main Allah ke siwaye apni jaan ke aur kisi ke liye kuch na kahunga, main to aaj apni walida Hazrat Maryam (Alaihas Salam) ke liye bhi kuch na kahunga jin ke batn se main paida hua hoon. Al-gharaz dost dost se, rishtedar rishtedar se munh chhupata phirega. Har ek apni hi dhun mein laga hoga, kisi ko dusre ka hosh na hoga.

Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Tum nange pairon, nange badan aur be-khatna Allah ke haan jama kiye jaoge. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki biwi sahiba ne daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Phir to ek dusron ki sharmgahon par nazrein padengi? Farmaya: Us roz ghabrahat ka hairat-angez hangama har shakhs ko mashghool kiye hue hoga, bhala kisi ko dusre ki taraf dekhne ka mauqa is din kahan? (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim).

Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne phir isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi: "Li-kullim-ri-im-minhum yawma-idhin sha'nun yughnihi". Dusri riwayat mein hai ke yeh biwi sahiba Hazrat Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) thin. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek din Hazrat Siddiqa (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha: Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Mere maa baap aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par fida hon, main ek baat puchti hoon zara bata dijiye. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Agar main jaanta hoon to zaroor bataunga. Pucha: Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Logon ka hashr kis tarah hoga? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Nange pairon aur nange badan. Thodi der ke baad pucha: Kya auratein bhi isi halat mein hongi? Farmaya: Haan.

Yeh sun kar Umm-ul-Momineen afsos karne lagin. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Ayesha! Is aayat ko sun lo, phir tumhein is ka koi ranj-o-gham na rahe ga ke kapray pehnay ya nahin? Poocha: Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) woh aayat kaunsi hai? Farmaya: "Likulli-imrin..." (Ek riwayat mein hai ke Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Sauda (R.A) ne poocha). Yeh sun kar ke log is tarah nangay badan, nangay paon, be-khatna jama kiye jayenge, paseenay mein gharq honge, kisi ke munh tak paseena pahunch jayega aur kisi ke kaanon tak, toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh aayat parh sunayi. Phir irshad hota hai ke wahan logon ke do garoh honge, baaz toh woh honge jin ke chehray khushi se chamak rahe honge, dil khushi se mutma'in honge, munh khubsurat aur noorani honge, yeh toh jannati jamaat hai. Dusra garoh jahannumiyon ka hoga, un ke chehray siyah honge, gard-aalood honge. Hadees mein hai ke un ka paseena misl-e-lagam ke ho raha hoga, phir gard-o-ghubaar para hua hoga. Jin ke dilon mein kufr tha aur aamaal mein badkari thi, jaise aur jagah hai aayat (Wala yaliduna illa fajiran kaffara - 71. Nuh: 27) yani un kuffar ki aulad bhi badkar kafir hi hogi. Surah Abasa ki tafsir khatam hui, Falhamdulillah!
